data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:

AMD NBIO (North Bridge IO) team delivers industry leading high-performance interconnects IP subsystems for all AMD products including Gaming APU and GPU, Client Desktop and Laptop APU, Server CPU and GPU etc. IP subsystems delivered by global NBIO organization includes PCIe, IOHUB (for high speed IO device routing and IO virtualization), CIT (for high speed interconnect among chiplets), DACC (for IO acceleration) and future opportunities. Global NBIO organization operates seamless from China, North America and Europe.

 

NBIO multi-subsystem interoperability, performance and emulation (MPME) team focus on interoperability verification, performance & power verification across subsystems, delivers performance architect models and emulation solutions for NBIO subsystems.

 

THE PERSON:

The successful candidate for this role will be an integral part of MPME team and focus on Multi-Subsystem Verification.  We are seeking a forward thinker to improve development process and drive innovation.

 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Be involved technically in the porting/creation of the DV environment for the new design, test plan creation and implementation, coverage analysis, and regression cleanup
  • Forward thinker to improve development process and drive innovation
  • Collaborate with global engineering team on implementation of multiple programs
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 

  • Solid knowledge on SystemVerilog, UVM, C/C++, Verilog
  • Solid background with hardware verification methodologies such as coverage-based verification methodology with the use of hardware assertions (PSL or SVA)
  • Solid knowledge on scripting language like Perl, python, ruby
  • Hands on experiences on NLP and be familiar with UPF is a big plus
  • Knowledge on PCIE is a big plus
  • Fluent verbal English for technical discussion with global team

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering 

 

LOCATION:

data.title: Business Administration & Operational Support Coordinator
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

 

THE ROLE

AMD is looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented Business Operations Coordinator in AI group to be the operational backbone of our team. You will own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, drive seamless purchase order execution, orchestrate team events, and serve as a trusted operations partner across multiple functions. If you thrive in a fast-paced tech environment, love solving problems before they happen, and take pride in making everyone around you more effective — this role was built for you.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Procurement & Purchase Order Management

  • Initiate, track, and close Purchase Orders (POs) end-to-end - from requisition creation through vendor invoicing and goods receipt
  • Partner with department leads to gather purchase requirements, validate budget alignment, and route approvals in accordance with AMD's procurement policy
  • Manage vendor relationships: obtain competitive quotes, negotiate pricing/terms, and maintain an approved vendor database
  • Ensure PO accuracy and compliance with internal controls; flag and resolve discrepancies with Finance, Accounts Payable, and Sourcing teams
  • Monitor open POs for delivery status, expedite as needed, and update ERP/procurement systems (SAP, Ariba, or equivalent) in real time
  • Conduct periodic spend analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities and report trends to leadership
  • Coordinate with Legal and Finance on vendor contract reviews, NDAs, and MSAs
  • Ensure all procurement activities adhere to AMD's ethics, sourcing standards, and local regulatory requirements

Team Events & Employee Experience Coordination

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute team events - including offsites, team-building activities, recognition programs, town halls, and leadership visits - from concept through post-event wrap-up
  • Manage event budgets, venue sourcing, catering, Audio/video setup, logistics and negotiate vendor contracts to maximize value
  • Develop and distribute event communications, agendas, and feedback surveys
  • Partner with HR and leadership to build an inclusive, engaging team culture.

Operational Support & Administration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operational needs across the team — space planning, facilities requests, equipment provisioning, shipping, receiving, lab coordination and asset tracking
  • Manage onboarding logistics for new hires: equipment, system access coordination, desk setup, and Day 1 readiness
  • Support budget management: track departmental spending, flag variances, and assist in monthly/quarterly budget reconciliation
  • Maintain and continuously improve operational SOPs, process documentation, and SharePoint/Confluence pages creation and maintenance.
  • Coordinate cross-functional projects and action-item tracking; drive accountability without direct authority
  • Manage distribution lists, organizational charts, and team communication channels
  • Prepare gift letters, visa letters, required supporting documentation, and general administrative outputs
 
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Strong experience in an operations, procurement, office management, or executive support role - preferably in a technology company
  • Demonstrated experience in creating and managing Purchase Orders within an ERP or procurement platform (SAP, Ariba, or similar)
  • Strong command of Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint); able to build trackers, dashboards, and reports independently
  • Proven track record of planning and executing corporate events of varying scale
  • Exceptional organizational skills - you manage multiple competing priorities without dropping a ball
  • Experience working within a global, matrix semiconductor or high-tech company
  • Familiarity with Coupa, Ariba, or SAP S/4HANA procurement modules
  • Exposure to budgeting and financial reporting processes
  • Experience using AI tools to draft communications, meeting summaries, reports, process documentation, and operational procedures while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
  • Ability to use AI-assisted solutions to analyze data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights that support business operations and decision-making
  • Comfortable learning and adapting to new AI technologies as they evolve and integrating them into day-to-day administrative and operational activities

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS :
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or related field
  • CPSM, CSCP, or equivalent procurement/supply chain certification is a plus

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE:

This position serves as a Staff-level HR compliance expert for SEA countries and is responsible for leading HR compliance, employment governance, audit readiness, regulatory change implementation, and HR compliance project execution across Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Thailand, and Indonesia. The role partners closely with Legal, Employee Relations, HRBPs, Payroll, Total Rewards, Finance, HR Technology, HR Service Center and EHS to ensure HR policies, employee lifecycle practices, statutory documentation, governance routines and operating processes remain compliant, practical, scalable and audit ready.

THE PERSON:

You are a proactive, detail-oriented and experienced HR compliance professional who can work independently, exercise sound judgment and influence effectively across a matrixed regional environment. You are knowledgeable in employment legislation, HR policies and processes, audit and control practices, HR tools and regional HR operations. The position requires strong communication, project management, problem-solving and stakeholder advisory skills, with the ability to translate complex legal or compliance requirements into clear, practical and sustainable HR actions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

1. Compliance Execution & Monitoring (40%)

  • Monitor employment law’s regulatory updates and assess their operational impact on HR policies, processes, systems, documentation, and employee lifecycle activities.
  • Coordinate implementation of approved statutory requirements covering wages, working hours, leave, social security, employment contracts, appointment letters, and other mandatory records through respective COEs.
  • Perform periodic statutory reporting compliance checks, identify gaps or process deviations, assign actions, and monitor remediation through closure.
  • Support implementation and localization of employee rule book as required in partnership with Legal, Employee Relations, and relevant COEs.
  • Translate approved requirements into practical workflows, checklists, manager guidance, employee communications, and operating procedures.

2. Compliance Governance, Audit & Reporting (30%)

  • Maintain country compliance frameworks, statutory calendars, risk registers, control documentation, audit files, evidence repositories, and remediation logs.
  • Coordinate internal reviews, statutory audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance assessments by preparing complete and accurate documentation and evidence.
  • Produce dashboards, RAG reports, scorecards, and governance updates highlighting compliance status, overdue actions, trends, and material risks.
  • Escalate unresolved or systemic compliance gaps with clear facts, business impact, ownership, and recommended operational next steps.
  • Facilitate root-cause analysis and strengthen controls, documentation quality, and accountability to prevent recurrence.

3. Regulatory Implementation & Project Management (20%)

  • Manage compliance and regulatory implementation projects from assessment and planning through execution, governance review, closure, and transition to business-as-usual operations.
  • Define scope, deliverables, success measures, owners, RACI, timelines, dependencies, controls, risks, and governance routines.
  • Coordinate Legal, Employee Relations, HR Operations, HRBPs, Payroll, Finance, Total Rewards, HR Technology, HR Service Centre, Communications, and business stakeholders.
  • Track milestones, actions, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations; prepare concise governance and executive status updates.
  • Coordinate approved change-management activities, including communication, readiness, process or system updates, and training materials.

4. Stakeholder Coordination & Operational Guidance (10%)

  • Guide HR stakeholders on the consistent execution of approved statutory and policy requirements.
  • Explain compliance controls, process requirements, ownership, and evidence expectations in clear, business-friendly language.
  • Partner with Legal for legal interpretation and advice, and with Employee Relations for case-specific or workforce-relations matters; refer issues outside this role’s execution and governance remit to the appropriate owner.
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up, confidentiality, and sound judgment while managing competing priorities and stakeholder concerns.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and strengthen HR compliance processes across the covered countries.
  • Promote a culture of compliance ownership, proactive risk identification, continuous improvement, and operational discipline across HR teams.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Technical / Compliance Skills
    • Working knowledge of employment-law compliance requirements and their application to HR operations
    • Compliance monitoring, control design, audit readiness, and evidence management
    • Policy and process implementation, statutory documentation, and employee lifecycle controls
    • Risk identification, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, and escalation judgment
    • Knowledge of implementation AI to do the work smarter however validating the responses for misjudgment / assumptions by AI tools

  • Project Management Skills
    • End-to-end project planning and execution
    • RACI, milestone, dependency, risk, issue, and action management
    • Governance facilitation and executive status reporting
    • Change, communications, and stakeholder-readiness coordination
    • Lead and govern change, Track executive presentation of HR compliance status and Gaps with risks

  • Behavioural Skills
    • High attention to detail
    • Confidentiality and ethics
    • Strong judgment under pressure
    • Ability to influence without direct authority
    • Calm handling of sensitive issues
    • Strong written and verbal communication
    • Ability to simplify complex legal or compliance requirements for stakeholders
    • Lead Change and pioneering new initiatives with constant thirst to enhance using the AI technology

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent practical HR project experience preferred.
  • Exposure to regional or multi-country HR compliance projects is an advantage.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or related discipline.
  • Certification or diploma in Labour Laws / Employment Law / Industrial Relations preferred.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

 

THE ROLE

The IOHUB team at AMD is seeking a Principal ASIC Design Engineer to provide technical leadership for the development of next-generation IP that enables AMD products across server, data center, client, and embedded markets. As a senior member of the team, you will help define and deliver innovative technologies that manage and optimize AI-driven data movement, enabling industry-leading performance, scalability, security, virtualization, and power efficiency.

In this role, you will collaborate with architecture, design, verification, firmware, implementation, and product teams across AMD to transform complex product requirements into robust silicon solutions. You will have the opportunity to influence technical strategy, drive architectural innovation, mentor engineers, and help shape engineering best practices that support AMD's future generations of AI and high-performance computing products.

 

THE PERSON

You are a collaborative and technically influential engineering leader who thrives in solving complex design challenges and driving execution across multidisciplinary teams. You combine strong architectural judgment with a practical, results-oriented approach to problem solving and are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments.

You are passionate about mentoring engineers, elevating technical quality, and promoting scalable design methodologies. You communicate effectively across organizations, build alignment among stakeholders, and demonstrate ownership in driving challenging technical issues to closure. You also embrace emerging technologies, including AI-enabled engineering tools, to enhance productivity, design quality, and development efficiency.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with architecture teams to evaluate technical trade-offs, define requirements, and translate product objectives into scalable and high-quality design solutions.
  • Drive design quality and implementation readiness by ensuring designs meet functional, timing, area, power, security, and reliability goals.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration among architecture, design, verification, firmware, physical design, and product teams to achieve program milestones and successful product delivery.

  • Experience collaborating across architecture, design verification, implementation, firmware, and post-silicon engineering organizations.
  • Proficiency with Verilog, SystemVerilog, and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl for design automation and productivity improvements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:

This is an exciting opportunity to work in the AMD SOC Verification Team as Silicon Design Verification Engineer where you will work with a team and experts in verification.

 

THE PERSON:

The candidate will have an opportunity to work on state of the art verification environment using UVM verification methodology and C. Besides owning block level test bench, the candidate will have opportunity to work on sub system level verification and other aspects of verification such as performance verification, power aware verification.

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems.

  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks and close the coverage.
  • Coordinate with RTL engineers to implement logic design for better clock gating and verify the various aspects of the design

AMD is seeking a Server Systems Assembly Manufacturing Engineer to drive manufacturing excellence for our growing Data Center GPU (DCGPU), Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence products. In this role, you will work closely with AMD design and engineering teams, Contract Manufacturers (CMs), ODMs, CEMs, and suppliers to ensure products are designed and implemented with manufacturability, technical capability, quality, and capacity in mind.

 

You will play a key role in new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing process development, and sustaining engineering across our global manufacturing partner network. This role will help advance AMD's assembly processes by applying innovative manufacturing technologies, industry best practices, and solutions for New, Unique, Different, and Difficult (NUDD) assembly methods, materials, components, and technologies.

THE PERSON:

The successful candidate is a hands-on manufacturing engineering professional who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. You are comfortable working across geographically distributed engineering, supplier, and manufacturing teams and can effectively lead technical discussions and drive issues to resolution.

You bring strong technical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate independently while managing changing products, suppliers, priorities, and responsibilities. You are comfortable working under schedule pressure and can serve as a trusted technical expert and liaison between AMD and our manufacturing partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead implementation and optimization of PCBA and server system assembly processes for NPI and high-volume manufacturing.

  • Manage DFx activities in partnership with internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners to identify and mitigate manufacturing risks and ensure required technical capabilities are in place.

  • Drive ODM/CEM manufacturing partners to achieve product quality, yield, and operational targets.

  • Develop, manage, and maintain manufacturing operational procedures and processes across AMD and manufacturing partner sites.

  • Develop efficient manufacturing assembly processes, including workflow, methods, materials, equipment, and detailed work instructions.

  • Lead engineering and technical meetings and cross-functional manufacturing projects.

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




The Role:

This is a great opportunity to join a global supply chain organization to influence across functions & regions (Finance, Business Units, Engineering), using your advanced product planning, analytical and problem-solving skills. We are seeking a Supply Chain Professional with NPI launch preparedness coordination, accuracy of supply plans for NPI/Sustaining products, cost/benefit analysis, and proactive inventory management.

 

The Person:

The Product Planner will be recognized as the expert of his/her product portfolio, and will drive outstanding processes, reporting and communication on a global scale. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and be change tolerant. You should also have executive level presentation skills, and strong organizational, problem-solving & analytical skills.

 

 Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze supply-demand matching, based on MRP system, to determine root cause changes, shortages and surpluses, and identify and drive course corrections.
  • Review all MRP inputs with functional owners to drive accountability and data accuracy (Yields, BOM, Capacity, etc.).
  • Provide product intelligence and required actions in the generation of the inventory forecast.
  • Articulate the difference between the demand plan (ship plan) and revenue plan (MOF). Drive discussion/ actions to close revenue commitment gaps by unit, and improve the overall health of the product(s).
  • Recommend demand shaping opportunities to achieve business goals.
  • Represent ISC and articulate supply and inventory plans at all meetings with key internal customers: PEO, Business Unit, and Production Control (PLPC). Examples: NPI Readiness/PM, Core Team, SCT, ISC Ops.
  • Drive disposition of inactive / hold inventory and represent ISC in meetings with the Business Units, Finance teams and Inventory Management.
  • Identify required demand mix for factory planner to execute to when managing the line and creating the Graded Die Forecast (GDF).
  • Manage OPN Constraints to align release dates, based on IP date and or manufacturing requirements.
  • Coordinate with data management (GPDM) for new BOM creation, based on new RIDV and post-processors.
  • Meet with Central Planning to identify part connections / disconnections in the BOM.

Preferred Experience:

  • Proven experience with Product Planning.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing environment.
  • Advanced supply chain analysis skills, as well as advanced Excel and Power Point skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Manufacturing and Inventory Management.
  • Know-how of supply chain theory and processes, operational execution & operations needs are critical. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate at all levels of the organization.  
  • Experience working in a semiconductor company or OSAT, with strong understanding of logistical system processes desired  
  • Advanced Planning system experience. 

  Academic Credentials:

  • BS or MS in Supply Chain, Industrial engineering / Operations or Business is preferred
